name: rosetta-reverse-a-string
code:
use default

reverse(text: string) -> string =>
    text |> reduce("", (reversed, character) => "{character}{reversed}")

write_line(reverse("asdf"))
write_line(reverse("Hello, World!"))
fullSource:
use default

reverse(text: string) -> string =>
    text |> reduce("", (reversed, character) => "{character}{reversed}")

write_line(reverse("asdf"))
write_line(reverse("Hello, World!"))
